page_title: PSG 3-1 LYO | PSG v Lyon 15/12/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' That's the end of the match.
90+4' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Alexandre Lacazette (Lyon) heads on.
90+2' Nicolas Tagliafico (Lyon) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
90+1' 5 additional min. will be played.
88' 3 - 1 Goal! Goncalo Ramos (PSG) fires the rebound low into the middle of the goal after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 3:1.

88' Lucas Perri was forced into action to thwart Bradley Barcola (PSG). He found himself some space after latching on to a pass and unleashed a shot to the bottom right corner but couldn't beat the keeper.
86' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Fabian Ruiz (PSG) will replace Ousmane Dembele.
86' What a big chance! Bradley Barcola (PSG) picks up an inch-perfect pass inside the box and fires the ball a whisker wide of the right post.
83' Pierre Sage has decided to make a change. Duje Caleta-Car (Lyon) replaces Jordan Veretout.
83' That will be all from Desire Doue who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Goncalo Ramos (PSG).
80' Benoit Bastien interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Leo Sauer.
79' A bullet header by Moussa Niakhate (Lyon) from inside the box has the power, but goes totally in the wrong direction, yards over the crossbar.
79' The ball goes behind for a corner. Lyon will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.

78' Malick Fofana (Lyon) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Lyon will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
77' Malick Fofana (Lyon) had time and space inside the box after picking up a neat pass, but his shot low towards the middle of the goal was comfortably saved by Gianluigi Donnarumma.
75' Half-chance! Bradley Barcola (PSG) plays a pass into the box, but Lucas Perri reacts well to snuff out the attack.
70' Bradley Barcola (PSG) delivers a low pass into the box which is intercepted.
66' Pierre Sage has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Said Benrahma (Lyon) replacing Rayan Cherki.
66' Substitution. Georges Mikautadze walks off the pitch and Alexandre Lacazette (Lyon) comes on as a substitute.
66' A substitution has been made. Ernest Nuamah is replaced by Malick Fofana (Lyon).
64' Luis Enrique prepares a substitution. Nuno Mendes is replaced by Lucas Hernandez (PSG).
63' A substitution has been made. Lucas Beraldo goes off and Marquinhos (PSG) comes on.
63' Kang-In Lee (PSG) does well to meet a cross from Vitinha, but he directs his shot just wide of the right post.
63' It's time for a substitution. Bradley Barcola (PSG) comes on in place of Kang-In Lee.
62' The ball possession is 64:36.
60' Rayan Cherki (Lyon) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Gianluigi Donnarumma intercepts the ball.
60' Rayan Cherki (Lyon) takes a short corner kick.
60' The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Lyon. Rayan Cherki (Lyon) sends a pass into the penalty area, but the opponent manages to cut it out.
59' Rayan Cherki (Lyon) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
55' The referee looks satisfied after his VAR review and duly disallows the goal for offside. The PSG players look gutted.
53' Wait! Referee Benoit Bastien immediately makes the VAR signal, most likely to see if there was an offside in the build-up play.
52' Gooal! No wait, it's been ruled out for offside. Desire Doue (PSG) disagrees, but the linesman is sure about his call.
51' Kang-In Lee (PSG) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance.
51' A long ball forward to Ousmane Dembele (PSG) is intercepted. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for PSG.
50' Warren Zaire-Emery (PSG) fires a volley towards goal from the edge of the penalty box and forces the goalkeeper to make a brilliant save.

50' Warren Zaire-Emery (PSG) meets a pass on the edge of the penalty area and shoots towards the middle of the goal. He didn't put enough power into the effort, though, and Lucas Perri pulls off an easy save.
49' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Lyon.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+5' The match has reached half-time.
45+2' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Jordan Veretout (Lyon) was quite harsh and Benoit Bastien didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
45' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.

44' Jordan Veretout (Lyon) picks up the rebound inside the penalty area and drills a good shot to the middle of the goal. Gianluigi Donnarumma shows how quick his reflexes are and dives superbly to stop the effort. What a save but what a wasted opportunity!
41' Georges Mikautadze (Lyon) is cautioned by the referee, who shows him a yellow card.
41' Gianluigi Donnarumma (PSG) goes into the referee's book. Yellow card.
40' 2 - 1 Goal! Rayan Cherki finds Georges Mikautadze (Lyon) on the edge of the area, he times his run to perfection and beautifully chips the ball over the goalkeeper. 2:1.
38' Half-chance! Corentin Tolisso (Lyon) plays a pass into the box, but Gianluigi Donnarumma reacts well to snuff out the attack.
33' What a miss! The corner finds Lucas Beraldo (PSG) unmarked in the box with the goal at his mercy, but somehow he mistimes his header and sends it just wide of the left post.
33' Kang-In Lee (PSG) takes the ball to the corner flag and sends it into the box.
33' Achraf Hakimi (PSG) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. PSG have a corner.
30' Ousmane Dembele (PSG) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit chip pass.
26' Lucas Perri is alert and has a clear sight of a long through ball from Vitinha (PSG). Easy save!
25' The ball is cleared after Ousmane Dembele (PSG) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
23' A spell of possession for PSG in an attempt to control the game.

16' He should have scored! Kang-In Lee (PSG) latches onto a pull back in the box right in front of goal, but his shot towards the bottom right corner is pretty weak and Lucas Perri makes an easy save.
15' Yellow card. Kang-In Lee (PSG) goes into the book for a bad tackle on his opponent.
14' 2 - 0 Goal! Vitinha (PSG) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Lucas Perri into the bottom right corner.
14' Vitinha (PSG) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
13' Ernest Nuamah (Lyon) brings his opponent down. Benoit Bastien has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul.

13' Corentin Tolisso (Lyon) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Benoit Bastien blows his whistle for a foul. PENALTY to PSG! Almost the entire opposition team is gathered around the referee and complaining. However, the decision has been made and it's final.

8' 1 - 0 Goal! Ousmane Dembele (PSG) shows good awareness inside the box as he latches on to a brilliant pass and fires a first-time shot into the back of the net. Desire Doue assisted in the goal. 1:0.
6' A dangerous looking corner kick from Kang-In Lee (PSG) is cleared to safety by the defence.

5' Kang-In Lee (PSG) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety. Corner kick. PSG will have an opportunity.
5' Warren Zaire-Emery (PSG) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal.
4' Achraf Hakimi (PSG) sends a chip pass into the box, but Lucas Perri is quickest to intercept the ball.
1' Warren Zaire-Emery (PSG) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Benoit Bastien saw the whole situation.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Lyon will have the kick-off.
Benoit Bastien was nominated as the referee for this game.
Show lineups We now know the starting lineups. You can find them in the match details of this match.
